title.narrative: PROFISCO - Espirito Santo. Finance Administration Development Plan.
PROFISCO - Espirito Santo. Plan de Desarrollo de la Administracin de Hacienda

description.narrative: Los objetivos especificos son:Organizacin y gestin estratgica: Modernizar la estructura organizacional, el modelo de gestin y los procesos administrativos, adems de ampliar la capacidad de planificacin de la accin fiscal con base en investigaciones econmico - fiscales;Cooperacin inter-institucional: Compartir e intercambiar informaciones y ampliar la integracin con administraciones fiscales de otros niveles de gobierno.Administracin tributaria: incrementar la recaudacin estadal y promover servicios pblicos de alta cualidad;Administracin financiera y patrimonial: Mejorar la efectividad y calidad del gasto publico;Trasparencia y comunicacin: Aumentar la trasparencia, tica y elevado desempeo de la Administracin Fiscal;Gestin tecnolgica: Mejorar los sistemas de informacin, de gestin y de control, as como los servicios de soporte de sistemas;Gestin de recursos humanos: Profesionalizar la Administracin Hacendaria por medio de la elevada capacitacin de su cuerpo de servidores.

The specific objectives are: Strategic management and organization: Modernize the organizational structure, the management model and the administrative procedures, besides increasing the planning of fiscal activities based on economic and fiscal studies; Inter-institutional cooperation: Share and exchange information and increase the integration with fiscal administrations of other governments; Tax administration: increase the State's tax revenue and provide high quality service to taxpayers; Finance and patrimonial administration: improve the effectiveness and quality of public expenditure; Transparency and communication: Improve the transparency, the ethics, and the high standards of the Fiscal Administration; Technology management: Improve the information, management and control systems, as well as the service support systems; Human resources management: professionalize the Fiscal Administration through high level training of its civil servants.
